Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars

Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars is an RPG set in a world of swords and sorcery, told entirely through the medium of cards. The story follows a self proclaimed hero as they set off to slay a recently awakened dragon, presented in the manner of a tabletop RPG and playing out through narration from the gamesmaster.

Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars es un RPG ambientado en un mundo de espadas y hechicería, narrado íntegramente a través de cartas. La historia sigue a un héroe autoproclamado que parte a dar muerte a un dragón recién despertado. Se presenta al estilo de un juego de rol de mesa, y se desarrolla mediante la narración del director de juego.

Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden

Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden is a RPG set on a remote chain of islands that have been protected by the maidens for generations, but which now face destruction. The hero of the story vows to save the islanders and sets sail for the high seas, together with Laty, a girl who failed to become a maiden.

A touching tale set in a world of melancholic beauty, brought to you by the creative minds of Yoko Taro, Keiichi Okabe and Kimihiko Fujisaka.

Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden es un RPG ambientado en una remota cadena de islas que han estado protegidas durante generaciones por las doncellas, pero que ahora se enfrentan a la destrucción. El protagonista de la historia jura salvar a los isleños y zarpa hacia alta mar junto a Laty, una chica que no logró convertirse en doncella.

Un relato conmovedor ambientado en un mundo de melancólica belleza, realizado por las mentes creativas de Yoko Taro, Keiichi Okabe y Kimihiko Fujisaka.

games.originalName: Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden

fields.value: Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden
Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden

Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden, is a new standalone turn-based RPG adventure, that brings players to an illustrated world presented through the medium of cards as the third release in the Voice of Cards franchise, now giving players the ability to trap the monsters they defeat in cards to use them as skills in battle.

This truly unique gaming experience brings back the creative minds behind the previous Voice of Cards games, beloved NieR series and Drakengard series, including: Creative Director, YOKO TARO (Drakengard series, NieR series), Music Director, Keiichi Okabe (Drakengard 3, NieR series) and Character Designer, Kimihiko Fujisaka (Drakengard series).

Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden es una nueva aventura RPG por turnos independiente que transporta a los jugadores a un mundo ilustrado, presentado a través de cartas. Es la tercera entrega de la saga Voice of Cards y permite, por primera vez, atrapar en cartas a los monstruos derrotados para usarlos como habilidades en combate.

Esta experiencia de juego verdaderamente única recupera a las mentes creativas detrás de los juegos anteriores de Voice of Cards y de las queridas series NieR y Drakengard, entre ellas: el director creativo YOKO TARO (series Drakengard y NieR), el director musical Keiichi Okabe (Drakengard 3, serie NieR) y el diseñador de personajes Kimihiko Fujisaka (serie Drakengard).
